title: 第三章绝世武功武动青春第九版新书求推荐票求收藏第四章如能贡献几斤肉造福未来一辈子新书求推荐票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第三章绝世武功——武动青春·第九版【新书，求推荐票，求收藏】
“哈哈哈～～好啊，好啊，放学以后我们一起走，我们可说定了。”
刚刚才和自己前世今生记忆融合，脑子几乎等同于进水的王璃同学，是一点都没发现现在班里，这凝重如上坟一样的气氛，反而依旧笑嘻嘻的点头。
“嗯！”
顿时，小姑娘脸上的笑容更加明媚了。
“啊呸*｀へ′*！”
这一刻，这纷纷嚷嚷的班里面，不知道多少同学在心底狠狠地唾弃这个恬不知耻的小王童鞋。
并且再次在心底发誓，等到明天武道课的时候，一定要叫王璃这厮好看！
想刀了一个人的眼神，那是藏不住的。
王璃同学眯了眯眼，再看着全班同学的目光，突然丈二和尚摸不着头脑，转头把脸就自然而然的靠在元竹兄的脸颊边上：“元竹兄，我是哪里得罪他们了吗？他们怎么就这么看我？”
“不知道哩～”
李元竹挑着小拇指，将因为王璃靠的太紧而落在脸上的发梢轻撩到耳后，突又转头对王璃展颜一笑。
一瞬间的风情，不知崩碎了多少少年心底朦胧的玻璃心。
……
“老爹，妈！
我回来了。”
晚上六点多，从李元竹家吃完晚饭，又坐着车回来的王璃来到市郊区。
站在挂着“王家农家乐”
大牌子的铁门前，王璃哐哐哐得敲着自家大门，拉扯着嗓子眼儿大叫了好几声。
然后，噼里啪啦，哐啷哐叽的声音直接就从门后传来。

王璃听到声音，顿时心领神会，赶紧把双臂张开，似乎是在准备什么
“哎呀哇～哥哥你回来啦！”
眨眼的功夫，大门打开，只见一个粉嫩嫩的小女孩，笑着一下子就跳进了王璃的怀里。
接着，这小小萝莉跟個小猫似的，抱着王璃，在他身上嗅个不停。
“哥哥你刚刚一定又去李姐姐家了！
吸吸吸……我都闻到李姐姐身上的香味了。”
“哎呀，王璐璐小同学，就你的鼻子灵！”
王璃捏着妹妹王璐璐那玲珑可爱的小鼻子抖个不同，然后双手抱着妹妹像小猫仔似的颠了颠，突然猛地发出一声惊呼：“哎呀呀，不好啦，小小王同学，你好像又长胖啦！”
妹妹王璐璐闻言笑容一收，皱起小脸，直勾勾看着王璃，大有“我给哥哥你一个机会，让你再组织一次语言，要不然我这就哭给伱看”
的模样。
“哈哈哈哈?ω?hiahiahia。
被吓到了吧～让你一天到晚在外面散布你哥哥我的谣言。”
王璃笑着把妹妹放下来，伸手又揉揉捏捏她的两小腮帮子。
“好了，一天到晚就知道逗自家妹妹玩，有意思吗？”
跟着妹妹一起来开门的王母，看到儿子刚回来就在逗妹妹，没好气地把王璃捏着妹妹小腮帮的咸猪蹄打落。
“那坑定有意思啊，‘妹妹’这个物种不就是让哥哥天天逗着玩了嘛。”

"Hahaha~~Okay, okay, we'll go together after school, we've agreed."
Classmate Wang Li, who had just merged with the memories of his past and present lives, and whose brain was almost as wet as water, did not notice the solemn atmosphere in the class now, as if visiting a grave, but still nodded with a smile.
"Yeah!"
Suddenly, the smile on the little girl's face became brighter.
"Ah*｀へ′*!"
At this moment, many students in the class who were shouting and shouting deeply despised this shameless little boy.
And I vowed once again in my heart that when the martial arts class comes tomorrow, I will make this guy Wang Li look good!
You can't hide the look in someone's eyes.
Classmate Wang Li narrowed his eyes and then looked at the eyes of the whole class. Suddenly Monk Zhang Er was confused. He turned his head and naturally leaned his face against Brother Yuanzhu's cheek: "Brother Yuanzhu, did I offend them? Why do they look at me like this?"
"I don't know~"
Li Yuanzhu raised his little finger and gently pushed the ends of his hair that had fallen on Wang Li's face behind his ears. He suddenly turned to Wang Li and smiled.
The moment of amorous feelings shattered the hazy glass hearts of many young people.
…
“Dad, Mom!
I'm back. "
At around six o'clock in the evening, Wang Li, who had returned from Li Yuanzhu's house in a car after dinner, arrived at the outskirts of the city.
Standing on the wall hanging "Wang's Farmhouse"
In front of the big iron gate, Wang Li knocked on his door and shouted several times at the top of his lungs.
Then, crackling and clanking sounds came directly from behind the door.
Wang Li heard the sound and immediately understood it. He quickly opened his arms as if he was preparing something.
"Oh wow~ Brother, you are back!"
In the blink of an eye, the door opened, and a pink and tender little girl jumped into Wang Li's arms with a smile.
Then, like a kitten, this little loli hugged Wang Li and kept sniffing on him.
"Brother, you must have gone to Sister Li's house just now!
Breathe in, breathe in...I can smell the fragrance of Sister Li. "
"Oh, little classmate Wang Lulu, you have a great nose!"
Wang Li pinched his sister Wang Lulu's cute little nose and shook it. Then he held his sister with both hands and bumped her like a kitten. He suddenly exclaimed: "Oh, that's not good, little classmate Wang, you seem to have gained weight again!"
When her sister Wang Lulu heard this, she stopped smiling, wrinkled her little face, and looked directly at Wang Li, saying, "I'll give you a chance, brother, to organize your language again, or I'll cry to you right now."
appearance.
“Hahahaha?ω?hiahiahia.
You must have been frightened~ I let you spread rumors about your brother and me outside all day long. "
Wang Li smiled and put his sister down, stretched out his hands and kneaded her cheeks again.
"Okay, I know how to tease my sister all day long, is it fun?"
Queen Mother, who came to open the door with her sister, saw her son teasing her sister just after he came back. She angrily knocked off Wang Li's trotters that were holding her sister's cheeks.
"That pit must be interesting. Isn't this species of 'sister' meant for my brother to tease me every day?"
